title: GWAS as a Wikipedia history-and-convention node
dek: HapMap-era mountain of SNP tests, 5×10⁻⁸ folklore, Manhattan plots. The per-SNP GLM and kinship already live on stats-gwas.
story: Wikipedia's GWAS article is a history-and-convention node: common SNPs, array then imputation, a mountain of association tests, Manhattan and Q–Q plots, the 5×10⁻⁸ p-value folklore from ~1 million independent common-SNP tests.

stats-gwas already says the per-SNP model is a GLM plus structure. stats-population-structure and stats-fdr own the two usual lies (iid tests, one error language). This card is the encyclopedia object students search first.
Bacterial GWAS is not human GWAS with smaller n. Clonality makes 'independent SNPs' a fiction — the existing plate already growled; this card points there.
deep: 5×10⁻⁸ is not Wilks and not a Bayes factor.
Genomic inflation λ_GC is a bulk-null check, not a likelihood.
Replication in a new lineage is a scientific hold-out, not a software option.
Rare-variant burden tests are a different Wikipedia neighbour.
